product_metadata.title: Oceanstar Contemporary Wooden Magazine Rack, Espresso
features: Freestanding magazine and newspaper holder designed to easily reposition as needed
Ideal to store any assortment of magazine, newspaper or book collections
Will provide a contemporary and stylish look and add extra storage to your home or office
It's the perfect organizer to store small items such as iPad’s, tablets, laptop, electronics, etc
description: Get organized while looking chic. The espresso finished magazine rack by Oceanstar is made with bentwood. It holds magazines and books, and can complement any living room, bathroom, office, family room or bedroom with its beautiful espresso finish. This magazine rack's modern and sophisticated design, along with its storage functionality, makes it a very popular item as a home decor product or as a gift for loved ones. Espresso finish cut-out carry handles. 1/2-inch thick of espresso finished bentwood. Modern and sophisticated design. Contemporary style. Assembly required. Net weight: 5-pound. Gross weight: 7-pound. Unit Dimensions: 12-inch width by 13-inch depth by 12-inch height.
